oewn-07520080-n.learner: a feeling of caring and fellow feeling for someone or something

oewn-05678554-n.learner: a matter you take an interest in because it is important or it affects you

oewn-00955670-n.learner: a fight between armed forces on opposing sides during a war
examples: The ship was badly damaged in a short engagement with the enemy fleet.

oewn-10601606-n.learner: a person who works for another person, above all in that person's house

oewn-04734472-n.learner: a special quality you can feel around a person or thing but cannot touch
